notes: Read-only actions can run without asking. Settings → Agents & instance → Actions that run without asking lists commands and tools, such as Bash(techpro-lookup:*) or mcp__memstem__*, that Claude runs in Review actions without an approval card; everything else, and anything chained, piped or redirected, still asks. Writes cannot be listed. Each automatic approval is recorded. POCKET_TRUSTED_ACTIONS sets the server's list.
